facts.text: The hotel is set among tropical gardens in the heart of Beverly Hills.
facts.excerpt: Set among lush tropical gardens in the heart of Beverly Hills, The Peninsula Beverly Hills offers a distinctly personal approach to luxury.

facts.text: The hotel's address is 9882 South Santa Monica Boulevard, Beverly Hills.
facts.excerpt: 9882 South Santa Monica Boulevard, Beverly Hills, CA 90212, USA

facts.text: The hotel is located just steps from the Golden Triangle and Rodeo Drive.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula is located just steps from the Beverly Hills' ‘Golden Triangle’ and Rodeo Drive

facts.text: The complimentary house car drives guests within Beverly Hills and Century City in a classic Rolls-Royce or another luxury vehicle.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s complimentary house car drives guests within Beverly Hills and Century City in a choice of a classic Rolls-Royce or another luxury vehicle

facts.text: The hotel has its own on-site Airport Concierge team at LAX that meets guests at baggage claim for domestic flights and escorts them to a hotel car.
facts.excerpt: A five-star experience awaits from touchdown at LAX where a Peninsula Airport Concierge will meet guests at the baggage claim (domestic flights only), collect their luggage and escort them to a waiting hotel car.

facts.text: The Roof Garden menu is rooted in seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The menu is rooted in seasonal, locally sourced ingredients, paired with bright juices and polished cocktails.

facts.text: The Roof Garden's signature Green Juice blends cold-pressed apple, cucumber, spinach, celery, parsley, ginger, kale and lemon.
facts.excerpt: The Roof Garden’s signature natural juice "The Green Juice" is a delicious blend of cold-pressed apple, cucumber, spinach, celery, parsley, ginger, kale and lemon.

facts.text: The rooftop pool and hot tub look out over the Los Angeles and Century City skyline.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by panoramic views of the Los Angeles and Century City skyline, The Peninsula Beverly Hills’ reimagined 60-foot outdoor rooftop pool & hot-tub is an idyllic spot

facts.text: Hotel guests can rent private poolside cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests can rent one of (8) private standard cabanas and (2) private deluxe cabanas overlooking the hot tub

facts.text: There are a dozen guest cabanas around the rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: rooftop swimming pool epitomises Hollywood glamour, surrounded by a dozen spacious guest cabanas

facts.text: Poolside manicures, pedicures and reflexology in a private pool cabana are offered seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: The Spa at Peninsula Beverly Hills offers poolside manicures, pedicures in our spa cabana, and reflexology in a private pool cabana seven days a week.

facts.text: The spa uses products from Biologique Recherche and Medical Beauty Research.
facts.excerpt: Refresh and reset your skin, body and nails with a wide range of offerings highlighting products from Biologique Recherche and Medical Beauty Research.

facts.text: The spa has seven treatment rooms, a private nail suite, a spa cabana and a serenity lounge with city views.
facts.excerpt: The Spa features seven welcoming treatment rooms, a private nail suite, a spa cabana, women’s and men’s changing rooms and a serenity lounge with views of the city.

facts.text: Guests must be 18 or older to use the spa.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 18 years of age or older in order to utilize The Spa.

facts.text: The Wellness Spa Cabana offers a cold plunge experience.
facts.excerpt: Introducing the newest addition to the Wellness Spa Cabana at The Peninsula Beverly Hills: The Cold Plunge All-In.

facts.text: Ricari Studios offers advanced wellness treatments exclusively at the spa.
facts.excerpt: Exclusively at The Spa, Ricari Studios offers a curated menu of advanced wellness treatments designed to support circulation, recovery, and cellular vitality.

facts.text: The Hair Atelier is owned by hair stylist David Pierre and offers haircuts, styling, blowouts and hair and scalp treatments.
facts.excerpt: Offering haircuts, styling, blowouts, and reparative hair and scalp treatments, The Hair Atelier is owned by renowned hair stylist David Pierre

facts.text: The fitness center has Woodway treadmills and Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: from the impressive Woodway treadmills and Peloton bikes to the range of Life Fitness equipment

facts.text: The fitness center locker rooms include Himalayan salt saunas.
facts.excerpt: spacious locker rooms, complete with Himalayan Salt Saunas, showers and a designated relaxation area

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have French doors opening to views of the gardens, fountain or Beverly Hills skyline.
facts.excerpt: The Deluxe Rooms are bright and airy with French doors that open to the Californian sunshine and views of the landscaped gardens, fountain, or the Beverly Hills skyline.

facts.text: Patio Deluxe Rooms have a private garden patio with outdoor furniture.
facts.excerpt: give guests that extra touch of luxury with a private garden patio featuring outdoor furniture for al fresco dining or relaxation.

facts.text: Ground-floor Villa Suites have an outdoor patio with a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Villa Suites on the ground floor feature their own unique design that includes an outdoor patio with a hot tub

facts.text: Villa Suites have separate living and sleeping areas, and the lounge sofa converts to a double bed for families.
facts.excerpt: Separate living and sleeping areas provide plenty of room for families to share, with the lounge sofa fully convertible to a double bed.

facts.text: The two-story Peninsula Villa has hand-painted Chinoiserie panels.
facts.excerpt: The two-story Peninsula Villa truly feels like a luxurious residence. The décor epitomises the fusion of Asian and contemporary Peninsula heritage with hand-painted Chinoiserie panels

facts.text: The Executive Villa Suite has a kitchenette with Viking appliances and two fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: including a state-of-the-art kitchenette with Viking appliances, two fireplaces, hardwood floors and rich area rugs.

facts.text: The hotel is marking its 35th anniversary.
facts.excerpt: Our thirty-fifth anniversary honors these enduring traditions and the philosophy behind them.

facts.text: The hotel's Library is a collection of books and vinyl records.
facts.excerpt: Our Library is a collection of books and vinyl records celebrating the relationship between travel, imagination, and memory.

facts.text: For the anniversary, Afternoon Tea includes a commemorative coin inspired by the Flight to Infinity fountain and a Wish Cake.
facts.excerpt: This anniversary introduces a new tradition: a commemorative coin inspired by our _Flight to Infinity_ fountain and a Wish Cake

facts.text: The spa was named one of the Top 10 Spas worldwide by SpaFinder readers.
facts.excerpt: Named one of the Top 10 Spas worldwide by readers of SpaFinder

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes it as a classic French chateau-style hotel.
facts.excerpt: This classic French château-style hotel in one of America’s most desirable zip codes

facts.text: Regular guests get monogrammed pillows, and so do their dogs.
facts.excerpt: If you’re a regular at this palatial pad, you’ll be treated to monogrammed pillows, and the same goes for your pet pooch.

facts.text: Personal trainers are available on request for one-on-one yoga and Pilates sessions.
facts.excerpt: customise your workouts with one of our personal trainers, available on request, for one-on-one coaching sessions in yoga and Pilates.

facts.text: The hotel is 11.47 miles from Los Angeles International Airport.
facts.excerpt: 11.47 miles / 18.5 km from Los Angeles International Airport

facts.text: In-room spa services carry an additional 20% surcharge.
facts.excerpt: There is an additional 20% surcharge for all in-room services.
